id.description: Stable unique identifier for this action, used for dependency resolution and retries. Must be unique across all actions and subactions.

description.description: Human-readable explanation of what this action accomplishes. Should clearly describe the goal of the action.

action_type.description: Canonical action category used by the orchestrator to determine execution strategy. Must be exactly one of the allowed enum values.

dependencies.description: List of action IDs that must complete successfully before this action can run. Can reference both actions and subactions.

mcp_context.description: Specific MCP tool invocation context. Only meaningfully used when action_type is 'mcp_tool_call'. Otherwise should still be present but not used.

server_id.description: Target MCP server identifier. Must remain empty or placeholder unless explicitly defined.

tool_name.description: Specific tool to invoke on the MCP server.

parameters.description: Arguments to pass to the MCP tool. Must be a complete object when used.

required_inputs.description: List of inputs required by the user to perform this action that are missing from the knowledge base. THEY MUST NOT REFERENCE FROM PREVIOS ACTIONS

output.description: Expected result produced by the action if successful. Should describe the outcome, not the process.

error.description: Error message or diagnostic information if the action fails. Leave empty if no error is expected.

subactions.description: Optional nested subactions to further decompose this action. Each subaction follows the exact same schema as a top-level action. Use this to break complex actions into smaller, manageable steps.

description: List of actions representing the full task decomposition. Each action may optionally include nested subactions for hierarchical execution.
